Q6181.reason: Preterm birth complications were the leading cause of under-five deaths in 2017.

Q9001.reason: About 9-10% of the world lived below $1.90 a day in 2019. That is roughly 700 million people, not the 1.9 billion in the note.

Q9006.reason: Global terrorism deaths in 2017 were in the tens of thousands, about 26,000, not a few hundred.

Q9007.reason: Global adult literacy in 2015 was about 86%, and it has been rising, not falling.
